notes: parts: the styles of the elements of the axis view, matched against the transcribed recipes.
src 'author': the option wrote the value along upstream's chain; 'theme': the theme's default (the skin in the port).
lineDash as the style holds it: a word ('dashed', 'dotted', 'solid'), a list, or null; the canvas normalises a word against the width.

cases.note: axisLine.lineStyle.color on a category x axis with ticks and a name: the ticks, the arrows and the name follow it
axisLine.lineStyle width 3, dashed, opacity 0.5, cap butt, dashOffset 2 on a value y axis shown
axisTick.lineStyle's own colour, width, [3, 2] and opacity over the line's colour
minorTick.lineStyle written; the y axis' line shown in its own colour
minorTick with no lineStyle: the line's colour, not axisTick.lineStyle's (getLineStyle on the axisTick model reads its own keys)
axisTick.color / width written on the axisTick itself: the minor ticks read them
splitLine width 2, dashed, opacity 0.5 and a list of two colours
splitLine type 'dotted' and width 2 alone: the skin's colour
splitLine type [5, 10], dashOffset 3, cap round
minorSplitLine shown with its own colour, width, dotted and opacity
splitArea areaStyle colours and opacity 0.5
splitArea areaStyle opacity alone: the theme's colours at that opacity
nameTextStyle.color over the line's colour
a root textStyle colour and the line's colour: which one the name takes
the candlestick-sh-2015 look: both axes in #8392A5, no split lines, y line shown
axisLine.lineStyle.color 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)' with width 2: an alpha colour on the line, its arrows and ticks
a single axis: line, tick, split line, split area and name in the author styles
angle and radius axes: line, tick, minor tick, split line, minor split line and area in the author styles
parallelAxisDefault's axisLine colour and width, an axis' own tick style and name colour
a radar: line, ticks, split line and split area in the author styles
showBackground with no backgroundStyle: the theme's strip
backgroundStyle.color
a border colour, width, dashed type and phase; an opacity
a border colour with no width: no pen (the default borderWidth 0)
borderRadius [6, 6, 0, 0] with a colour
a linear gradient colour
color 'none': no fill
a bar on a polar, its background sector in the author style
lines, colorBy 'data': each line's stroke; one its own lineStyle colour
a parallel series, colorBy 'data': each line's stroke; one its own
itemStyle.borderRadius 5 on the series, one item its own 1
levels' borderRadius [4, 0], an array on the second level

guards.name: no case fails its recipes
the ticks follow the line's colour
the arrows follow the line's colour
the name follows the line's colour
the axis line has a round cap unless written
a minor tick takes the line's colour, not axisTick.lineStyle's
a minor tick reads axisTick's own color / width
a split line list draws one style per colour
nameTextStyle's colour wins
the angle axis' line has no round cap
a background strip per bar
backgroundStyle.color is the fill
a border with a width is a pen
a border with no width is width 0
a polar bar's background is a sector
a gradient fill stays a gradient
lines colorBy 'data'
parallel colorBy 'data'
a treemap's rects take the radius
a level's radius
